# Bundled flags

| Set | Files | License | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| flag-icons 7.6.0 | `android/ui/src/desktopMain/resources/flags/*.svg` (the 4:3 flags of two-letter country codes) | [MIT](flag-icons-MIT.txt) | [lipis/flag-icons](https://github.com/lipis/flag-icons) |

The desktop shows these in place of flag emojis, which Windows' emoji font draws as two letters
(sources' language lists use them). Android's emoji font draws flags itself and does not bundle
them. The files are unmodified; the set's regional flags (such as `gb-eng`) are left out.
